name: v40 settings sensitivity ROUND 2 (extension of settings_protocol.json) -- rev 5, FROZEN
status: FROZEN (rev 5): reference hashes re-verified at freeze; authorized_implementation_commits set to the exact tested SHA; run from a detached worktree at that commit. The freeze commit is whichever commit adds this file; its md5 is recorded in every run_meta.
frozen_at_commit: n/a: a file cannot contain the SHA of the commit that first adds it; the freeze commit is whichever commit adds settings_protocol_v2.json, and its md5 is recorded in every run_meta

disclosure.statement: This protocol was written AFTER the round-1 results (settings_protocol.json; results commit 2a79b27f, fix round 673dfdbe) were seen. It is a post hoc scope extension, not a blind pre-registration. No level was chosen, kept or dropped using a round-1 r value. Levels come from the April 2026 grid (gridsearch/generate_grid.py:11-17), code-supported values, or the sensitivity steps described under gex_detection_k / gex_detection_min_corr.
limitations_first_class: GEX-side GMM is NOT tested: detect_cell_types_gex has its own hardcoded 2-component GMM and adaptive threshold (CITEgeist/model/deconvolution/detection_refinement.py:111-125, 168-192) and is called whenever GEX detection is on (citegeist_model.py:1067-1084). Protein-side GMM variants and k / min_corr do not cover it. Do NOT write 'all detection settings'.
all SACE settings are untested (max_iter / EM loop, embedded QP settings, cells_per_spot, init_method, bandwidth)
filter_gex min_counts, preprocess_gex target_sum, antibody winsorization 5/95 are untested
simulation, GeoMx and clinical Visium settings; random seeds are untested
nuclei_prior_lambda is NOT tested (dropped, see dropped_settings)
the 5 regions come from one Xenium experiment; they are not independent tissue replicates

dropped_settings.nuclei_prior_lambda: Dropped entirely (controller ruling, Codex review). The published call passes nuclei_counts (cellularity spot weights, citegeist_model.py:818-832). nuclei_prior_lambda is read only inside `if use_nuclei_prior:` (citegeist_model.py:838-857), a deprecated path (DeprecationWarning at :841-846). Turning it on also adds an abundance target, changes row_sum_bounds to (0.25, 2.5) (:851) and adds a penalty term (qp_solver.py:1493-1499), so it is not a lambda test of the published model. April also used max-normalized StarDist targets without nuclei_counts (gridsearch/run_props_gridsearch.py:54-61, 148-160), so a baseline-anchored version would not reproduce April either.

extends.note: Round-1 file not modified. Same baseline, regions, panels, metric, robustness rule, tie-break.

metric: pearson_r (overall per-region proportion Pearson r vs SingleR GT; rmse/mae/jsd recorded)

baseline.description: Identical to round 1: baseline.run_xenium_qp published call = filter_gex(min_counts=25), preprocess_gex(target_sum=10000), preprocess_antibody, load_cell_profile_dict(profile), run_cell_proportion_model(lambda_laplacian=0.0, nuclei_counts=<label-derived>); every other kwarg at its production default. Uses protein-gated cell labels for nuclei counts (not label-free).
baseline.gate_reference: results/gate (A11). The R2 baseline is re-run and must equal the A11 gate within 1e-4 per region and panel BEFORE any delta is read.

robustness_rule.statement: A level is robust iff |mean over regions of (r_level - r_baseline)| <= 0.02 AND no region has |r_level - r_baseline| > 0.05

status_values.inert: detection-mask hash (fused mask) equals the baseline hash in EVERY region of that panel: the level did not change the solver input. No robust yes/no; excluded from all headline denominators; reported with its effective thresholds.
status_values.not_estimable: any region failed/missing, or the diagnostics needed to establish inertness are missing. No robust yes/no; reported with the failure status.

robustness_rule.headline_rule: Headline 'robust X of Y' counts only PRODUCTION-family levels with status ok. Benchmark-only detection variants are reported in their own section and never enter X or Y. The allowed phrase is 'robust to one-at-a-time perturbation of N QP-stage Xenium settings' where N counts production-family estimable settings.

fusion_mode.level_evidence: all modes supported by fuse_detection_masks (detection_refinement.py:224-252); anything else raises.

gex_detection_k.level_evidence: post-R1, pre-execution sensitivity steps (half / double the default); not documented as r-optimized and not from a pre-R1 artifact.
gex_detection_k.override: direct kwarg gex_detection_k. Diagnostics log per-type candidate-gene counts and the all-True fallback types (fewer than 3 candidates means no GEX gate for that type, detection_refinement.py:147-162).

gex_detection_min_corr.level_evidence: post-R1, pre-execution sensitivity steps (permissive / strict bracket in the valid [0,1] range, H clipped at detection_refinement.py:100-101); not documented as r-optimized.
gex_detection_min_corr.override: direct kwarg gex_detection_min_corr; same candidate-count / fallback diagnostics.

gmm_n_components.level_evidence: provenance audit row 'Detection gating (GMM 2-comp)': commit 6feea54b tested multi-component GMM ('2-comp optimal').
gmm_n_components.semantics_K_gt_2: Only the single highest-mean component (argmax of summed component means, detection.py:134-136) is treated as signal; all other components, including intermediate-high ones, count as absent. This is an implementation variant of the detector, not a natural extension of background-vs-signal gating.
gmm_n_components.override: BENCHMARK-ONLY: GaussianMixture in the detection module is replaced for ONE condition by a factory that REPLACES the n_components keyword (settings_conditions.make_gmm_factory); restored on exit. Production source is not edited.

gmm_base_threshold.level_evidence: symmetric steps of 0.2 around 0.5 inside the valid posterior range (0,1); no pre-R1 artifact; not documented as r-optimized.
gmm_base_threshold.known_property: With adaptive_threshold=True the base is used only when the signal weight is in [0.5, 0.7); other weights give fixed 0.3 / 0.4 / 0.6 (detection.py:46-59). Often inert by construction; inert status is determined from the mask hash, not assumed.
gmm_base_threshold.override: BENCHMARK-ONLY: detection.detect_cell_types replaced for ONE condition by a wrapper that REPLACES the existing threshold= keyword (settings_conditions.make_detect_wrapper). NOT functools.partial (production already passes threshold=0.5; a partial would be silently overridden by the call-time keyword).

gmm_adaptive_threshold.level_evidence: code-supported kwarg of detect_cell_types (detection.py:67); 'off' makes the posterior threshold a fixed 0.5.
gmm_adaptive_threshold.override: same wrapper, REPLACES adaptive_threshold= with False.

joint_block.purpose: Primary answer to 'did tuning on test regions inflate r': the April grid tuned alpha, lambda_reg, lambda_laplacian and detection_gate_ub JOINTLY (gridsearch/run_props_gridsearch.py:148-160), so a one-at-a-time check cannot answer it. Full factorial over the April levels of these four active production parameters, then leave-one-region-out over combinations.
joint_block.level_source: April grid: Benchmarking/xenium_benchmarking/CITEgeist/gridsearch/generate_grid.py:11-17. ALL April levels of all four axes are included, including detection_gate_ub 0.05.
joint_block.baseline_cell_verification: Production alpha default 0.5 (citegeist_model.py:640, kwarg `alpha`, qp_solver.py:1474-1475), lambda_reg 1 (:639), published lambda_laplacian 0.0 (baseline.py run_xenium_qp), detection_gate_ub 0.01 (:668). All four are levels of their axis, so the baseline is exactly one cell of the grid. The cell is not re-run: the baseline condition stands in for it.
joint_block.n_combos_note: 5 x 5 x 5 x 4 = 500 including the baseline cell, so 499 non-baseline combos are run. The baseline level of each axis is kept so the baseline is a grid cell.
joint_block.override: direct run_cell_proportion_model kwargs alpha (NOT alpha_elastic, which exists only on the per_type_beta path, citegeist_model.py:1190), lambda_reg, lambda_laplacian, detection_gate_ub (settings_conditions.resolve, axis 'joint').
joint_block.oat_slices: OAT levels of the four joint axes (other three at baseline) are READ from the joint block, not run separately. Round-1 levels are rerun inside round 2 as joint cells (lambda_reg 0.5/2, lambda_laplacian 0.01/0.03/0.1, detection_gate_ub 0.005/0.02/0.05). These 8 duplicated levels x 5 regions x 2 panels = 80 comparisons must ALL be present, status ok, finite and equal to round 1 within 1e-4, or the gate fails. No R1/R2 pooling; the OAT-range LORO uses R2 rows only (post-R1 secondary analysis of the union of OAT ranges).
joint_block.loro: For each panel and held-out region h: choose the combo with the highest mean r over the other four regions (baseline combo is a candidate; ties within 1e-12 go to the baseline; a combo failed/missing in any training region is ineligible). Report held-out r of the chosen combo, held-out r of the baseline, and gain = chosen - baseline, per region and as the mean over regions.

decision_rule.statement: Within the preregistered 4-axis joint block (alpha, lambda_reg, lambda_laplacian, detection_gate_ub), the R1.4 concern 'tuning on test regions inflated r' is ADDRESSED for a panel iff mean held-out gain over baseline <= 0.02 AND no region's held-out gain > 0.05; otherwise it is NOT ADDRESSED.
decision_rule.justification: Same thresholds as the round-1 robustness rule (mean 0.02, region 0.05), applied one-sided to the held-out GAIN because the question is inflation. Chosen from the round-1 rule, not from any result. Unchanged by the addition of the fourth axis.
decision_rule.primary_panel: 6-type; machine-readable fields primary_panel=6 and primary_decision. The 7-type verdict is secondary (secondary_decision_7type).
decision_rule.descriptive_only: in_sample_best_descriptive: the combo with the best mean r over all 5 regions and its gain over baseline (the optimism an in-sample April selection could have had). Not part of the rule.

caveats: LORO regions come from one Xenium experiment, not independent tissue replicates
nuclei_prior_lambda, which April also tuned, is dropped (see dropped_settings)
detection settings (fusion_mode, k, min_corr, protein GMM) are tested one-at-a-time only, not jointly with the QP axes

detection_gate_ub_choice.rule: all four April levels. Controller ruling: the joint test looks for inflation, so leaving out the level that was best one-at-a-time in round 1 (0.05) would weaken the test exactly where a reviewer would look.

joint_block.scope_statement: The verdict covers the April joint-tuning concern for the four active production parameters alpha, lambda_reg, lambda_laplacian and detection_gate_ub, at all April grid levels of those four axes. It does not cover nuclei_prior_lambda (dropped), the detection settings of this protocol jointly with the QP axes, the GEX-side GMM, the 7-type dictionary, SACE or preprocessing. The 5 regions come from one Xenium experiment.

expected_conditions.derivation: OAT detection = fusion_mode 2 + gex_detection_k 2 + gex_detection_min_corr 2 + gmm_n_components 2 + gmm_base_threshold 2 + gmm_adaptive_threshold 1 = 11; joint = 5*5*5*4 - 1 = 499; plus 1 baseline = 511. Tests assert these literals independently of this file's level lists.

fields: effective_thresholds (signal weight, base, effective) for every adaptive-threshold call
diagnostics_per_condition.inert_rule: level is inert iff mask_hash_fused equals the baseline's in every region of the panel

loro_oat: Per-setting OAT LORO as in round 1 (loro.select) may additionally be reported for the production-family levels; benchmark-only detection variants are labelled as such.

gpu_cost_estimate.round1_reference: round 1: 150 cells, 10 array tasks (jobs 4388144, 4388172), task elapsed 3:59-11:20 min per 15 cells incl. data load = 0.27-0.76 min per cell, mean about 0.4 min (sacct)
gpu_cost_estimate.estimate_wall: 10 array tasks x 511 cells: about 138-388 min per task (typical about 204 min = 3.4 h); about 3.4 h wall if all start together (worst case about 6.5 h). Per-task worst case 6.5 h is well inside the 24 h SBATCH limit, so the array size stays at 10.
gpu_cost_estimate.note: no SACE; LORO and aggregation run on htc.

gates_before_reading_deltas: report output dir must be new or empty; a non-empty dir is refused so a gate failure never sits next to stale summaries
fail-closed: if ANY gate fails, only settings_v2_gate_failure.json is written; no delta, LORO, headline or verdict is computed
reference inputs: A11 gate files and the R1 metrics file are loaded by the paths and sha256 in reference_files; exactly one A11 baseline row per panel-region; any hash mismatch fails
run provenance: protocol md5, authorized commit, conditions hash, no conflicting duplicate candidates
row count == 511 x 5 x 2 = 5110 and the condition-id set equals the set derived from this protocol, per region and panel
exact reference key sets, status ok and finite on both sides: R2 baseline r per region equals the A11 gate within 1e-4 (both panels)
all 80 R1 duplicate comparisons present, ok, finite and equal to round 1 within 1e-4
per-override tests, patch-scope tests, real-wiring test and baseline-kwargs equivalence pass

r1_duplicates.derivation: 8 round-1 levels that reappear as joint cells (2 + 3 + 3) x 5 regions x 2 panels = 80 (literal; the gate requires all 80)

authorized_implementation_commits_note: FILL AT FREEZE with the exact 40-lowercase-hex SHA(s) the runs may come from. Compared by equality; short prefixes, empty strings or anything else make the gate fail. Empty list = every run is rejected (fail-closed). Runs record repository HEAD, so run from a detached worktree AT the authorized commit with the frozen protocol copied in.
run_selection: Never by mtime. Every selected unit must carry run_meta settings_protocol_v2_md5 == md5 of the frozen file, an authorized git_hash, and conditions_sha256 == sha256 of json.dumps(build_list_v2()). Several complete candidates for one unit are accepted only if their metrics.csv are byte-identical.
headline_wording: robust X of Y estimable production-setting levels (levels, not settings); inert and not-estimable levels and benchmark-only variants are listed separately

reference_files.note: Exact reference inputs, pinned by sha256 and loaded by path (no directory scan, no mtime). Hashes computed on the draft date; the freeze operator must re-verify them before freezing.
